cues: Bone is the hardest connective tissue.
Its matrix is about one third protein, for toughness, and two thirds calcium salts, mainly calcium phosphate, for hardness.
In mammalian compact bone it is built in cylinders called Haversian systems.
A central Haversian canal carries a blood vessel and a nerve.
